messages.en:
{07 02 00}Incredible!{01 00 00 0f 00} Are you serious?
You caught one already?

{07 00 00}I tried my best, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}but my
best just wasn't good
enough, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Uskumatu!{01 00 00 0f 00} Kas sa tõsiselt?
Sa püüdsid juba ühe?

{07 00 00}Ma andsin endast parima,
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}aga mu parim polnud
piisavalt hea, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Oh, no!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}I can't believe you
already caught one!

{07 1a 00}I have to hand it to you,
{04 1f 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}You're just
plain amazing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Oh ei!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Uskumatu, et sa
juba ühe püüdsid!

{07 1a 00}Ma pean sulle au andma,
{04 1f 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}Sa oled lihtsalt
